summary: Task 44 (Feb 27, 2026) — Vendor commission + admin bookings analytics + unified vendor bookings table + show-up tracking. Full E2E validation on preview URL. 6/6 frontend test flows PASSED. Backend regression not re-run (main agent noted 7/7 pytest already green for task44).
critical_code_review_comments: UnifiedBookingsTable.jsx `inRange('week')` uses `>=weekAgo && <=now+7d` — spans 14 days centered on today rather than the intuitive 'past 7 days' or 'ISO week'. Same story for `month`. Consider clarifying label to 'Last 7 days' / 'Last 30 days' or using date-fns startOfWeek. Not a bug per se; observed working correctly for the QA data set.

UnifiedBookingsTable line 111 sets `listing_title: b.listing_id` for OFFLINE rows — user-facing UI ends up showing the raw listing_id string on offline rows (currently the `Customer` column is used, but if a future column adds title this will regress). Suggest resolving listing title from a lookup or omitting altogether.
VendorsTab.jsx `saveCommission` uses `Number()` on percent/flat — empty string coerces to 0 (valid), which silently sets 0% / ₹0 without warning. Consider treating empty-string as invalid.

BookingsAnalyticsTab.jsx polls `/admin/bookings-analytics?range=...` on every range change with no debounce or cancellation — rapid tab clicks stack requests. Acceptable for scale but note for future.
Commission form auto-restores to the previously-saved values when re-opening the form (uses `v.commission_percent ?? 10`) — good UX; verified during TEST 2.

backend/routes/booking_lifecycle.py lazy-sweep on read triggers a write inside a GET handler — verified working (past-date PLATFORM booking auto-flipped to expired in Test 6). Idempotent + fast, but consider caching last-sweep timestamp to avoid re-scanning on every request under load.
Vendor unified table `markNoShow` uses `window.confirm()` — automation friendly but a native confirm dialog is a UX friction on mobile web. Consider a custom shadcn AlertDialog for consistency.

Vendor `p5b_vendor_1` (offline_mode: true) shows business tab correctly. Other vendors in the QA DB have `offline_mode: None` — commission edits work regardless (approval endpoint accepts commission_percent + commission_min_flat on any vendor).
